summary: Unexplained jump in monthly invoice after model rollout; meter attribution changed
description: Issue summary: Customer reports ~3x increase on February invoice compared to January after they rolled out a committed model swap (quantized variant) on 2026-02-12. BrightHealth AI claims they did not increase traffic and used the Dedicated pool. They suspect metering attribution changed and tokens were billed at full-precision model rates rather than the quantized SKU. Impact: customer-facing finance team blocked; renewal discussion paused pending adjustment. Environment: Dedicated cluster in us-east, reserved capacity, model pinned to redwood-alpha-3b-quantized from 2026-02-12 to present. Invoice ID: INV-2026-02-BH-77. Attachments provided by customer: PDF invoice, CSV export from their usage dashboard, screenshot of model pin in their infra console.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer pinned model redwood-alpha-3b-quantized in Dedicated config on 2026-02-12.
3) Billing run executed on 2026-02-28, invoice generated and delivered.
4) Customer compared month-over-month token unit costs and observed a larger per-token rate applied for ~60% of FEB usage.
logs_or_evidence: Billing batch log: bill-run-2026-02-28: job completed, meter backend: meter-v2 index=us-east
Customer console screenshot: Dedicated model pin shows redwood-alpha-3b-quantized as active (attached)
Support reproduction note: observed subset of tokens in billing DB with model_label='redwood-alpha-3b' between 2026-02-12 and 2026-02-14
initial_support_comment: Acknowledged. Tier-1 reviewed attachments and escalated to Billing + Infra. Asked customer for the config export and recent API key activity; escalated to finance for provisional hold on invoice settlement. Case created and tagged urgent for dedicated customers.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-01 - Billing: ran reconciliation on customer invoices; matched 3,942,000 tokens billed at full-precision SKU dated 2026-02-12..2026-02-14.
2026-03-01 - Infra: inspected model routing metadata; found event where deployment orchestration emitted model_label override during canary rollout (PR #8421).

2026-03-02 - SRE: queried meter-v2 index for customer org id bh-ai-211; identified 62% of tokens on 2026-02-13 attributed to redwood-alpha-3b (non-quantized) despite runtime using quantized kernels per serving runtime logs.

2026-03-02 - Hypothesis: model_label mapping mismatch between serving runtime (runtime kernel) and metering pipeline (label extraction) during a short timeframe because PR 8421 changed label semantics for rollouts; meters continued to read 'model_name' field which temporarily defaulted to non-quantized name.
2026-03-03 - Finance: generated provisional credit run for suspect interval; pending engineering confirmation. Estimated adjustment: $16,150.00 credit if hypothesis confirmed.
comments: 2026-02-28 18:12 - Aisha Khan (Support): Thanks for raising this — we received your invoice and CSV. We're opening an investigation and placing a provisional hold on collection while we review.
2026-03-01 09:47 - Miguel Torres (Billing): Running reconciliation now; can you confirm whether any ad-hoc jobs ran that could have bumped token counts?

2026-03-01 10:05 - Customer (BrightHealth AI - finance@brighthealth.ai): No, traffic steady. Our telemetry shows the model name is the quantized SKU after the pin. We attached the pin export and runtime logs.

2026-03-02 14:22 - Lina Park (SRE): Found a short-lived model_label fallback in the orchestrator logs during canary 2026-02-12T15:02Z..15:15Z which maps to non-quantized name. Metering pipeline reads model_label; likely root cause.
2026-03-03 08:30 - Miguel Torres (Billing): Finance prepared provisional credit. Pending final verification from Infra and confirmation of full token set to adjust.
resolution: Provisional credit of $16,150.00 prepared and queued. Engineering confirmed a label-mapping bug introduced in rollout PR #8421 caused ~60% of tokens for 2026-02-12..2026-02-14 to be attributed to the non-quantized SKU in the metering pipeline even though the serving runtime executed the quantized kernels. Billing team will apply the credit to INV-2026-02-BH-77; customer will receive revised invoice. Permanent fix in metering label resolution deployed 2026-03-03 and backfill job scheduled to re-process affected logs and regenerate meter events for the interval.
follow_up_actions: 1) Run backfill on meter-v2 index for org bh-ai-211 covering 2026-02-12..2026-02-14 (owner: infra).
2) Apply credit against INV-2026-02-BH-77 and send revised invoice (owner: billing).
3) Add regression test for model_label semantics in rollout PR checklist (owner: platform).
4) Notify customer when backfill completes and provide reconciliation CSV (owner: CS).
closing_notes: Pending backfill completion. Customer informed that invoice is on hold and credit is queued; renewal discussion deferred until next week. Recommend cross-team postmortem for rolled-out label semantics change and billing impact.
